key_phrases: bullish about our opportunity in Generative AI
installed base of active devices reached an all-time high
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is cautiously optimistic. While iPhone and iPad revenues showed year-over-year declines, management successfully contextualized these as 'difficult compares' due to one-time supply chain impacts from the previous year. The Services segment remains a massive strength with double-digit growth and record highs. Management shows high confidence in AI (Generative AI) and emerging markets (India/SE Asia), though they were somewhat evasive regarding specific monetization timelines for AI and detailed competitive pressures in China. Quantitative specificity was high, with clear revenue, margin, and EPS figures provided. Capital expenditure remains steady with a focus on maintaining the existing hybrid investment model.
